pictures.author: Karelj; crop by Gugganij
pictures.observations: Useful courtyard close: stepped pale warm stucco masses, projecting stone cornices, lower west terrace with pale balusters, taller flat-roofed east block/iron terrace rail, sparse light closed shutters and a small pedimented upper house. Museum wings and Saint Peter's dome remain separate context.

pictures.author: Jean-Pol GRANDMONT
pictures.observations: Ordinary bird's-eye view from Saint Peter's dome locates the small stepped tower in the west museum wing. Low terraces and roof house join the long museum roof; do not replace or reconstruct the surrounding palace as part of this tower. Fine roof details are small at this resolution.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific standing Gregorian Tower exterior on its retained notched plan: low west chamber/stone balustraded terrace, taller east flat-roofed block/projecting cornice and iron roof rail, small pedimented upper house/pitched cap, sparse recessed closed light shutters, broad pilasters/string courses and bounded buried footings. Existing shared stucco, limestone, painted metal and wood graphs. No fresco/interior, copied coats of arms or inscriptions, photograph atlas, Saint Peter's dome or whole Vatican museum authored.
